```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
set.seed(42)

fish_file = read_csv("data/fish.csv") |> clean_names()
geo = fish_file |>
  filter(genus == "Geotria")
ggplot(geo, aes(x= total_length_cm )) +
  geom_histogram(bins=100) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of Total Length in Geotria Fish - Observed") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Number of fish") +
  theme_minimal()
```
